description: A photograph depicting a standing water body of an extractive industrial site under a clear blue sky, with a long industrial conveyor belt system running along its edge. The conveyor belt is loaded with gravel or similar aggregate material, indicating active open pit extraction. Scattered vegetation is visible on the far bank of the water body. Visible text in the lower left corner reads "©European Union, 2012" and "LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey).
